messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Replace the video's scene with the environment shown in the reference image. Keep the person's identity, hairstyle, hair color, clothing, expression, and action unchanged. Preserve the camera framing and movement, while adapting the lighting on the person to the target environment.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: I'd like to replace the video's scene with the environment shown in the reference image. Keep the person's identity, hairstyle, hair color, clothing, expression, and action unchanged. Preserve the camera framing and movement, while adapting the lighting on the person to the target environment.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"The character stands still, then begins to walk forward toward the camera, occasionally looking up and to the side.","camera":"The camera is positioned at a low angle, looking up at the character, and remains relatively static as the character approaches.","clothing":"A gold and brown plaid three-piece suit with a white shirt and a black tie, paired with black and white sneakers.","hair_color":"Dark brown or black.","hairstyle":"Short, dark hair, closely cropped on the sides and slightly longer on top.","identity":"A 3D-rendered male character with a light brown complexion, short dark hair, and a neutral facial expression.","scene":"An outdoor urban environment under a concrete overpass or bridge, with a road, traffic signs, and construction barriers visible in the background."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The background changed from a dark futuristic dome interior with neon rings to a daytime outdoor road under a concrete overpass with barriers and traffic signs, matching the reference. The character's pose, walking action, and low-angle framing remain similar, and the lighting now appears warmer and brighter. However, the suit changed from red/maroon plaid to gold/brown plaid, and the shirt appears more yellow-green than white.
arguments.requested_change: Replace the source scene with the reference overpass/road environment while preserving the person's identity, hairstyle, hair color, clothing, expression, action, and camera framing/movement, and adapt the person's lighting to the new environment.
uncertain: Whether the suit color change is an intended lighting adaptation or an unintended clothing change
unexpected_changes: Suit color changed from red/maroon plaid to gold/brown plaid
Shirt color shifted from white to yellow-green
